name: sql-query
about: A SQL query (query.sql, SQLite) that returns exactly the rows your reference query returns on your data: same columns count, same rows (in order only if you say so). As strong as your data: include the rows that tell a right query from a near miss.
instructions: Answer with one SQLite query (SELECT or WITH … SELECT) and nothing else; it runs against the tables described in the task.

data.about: CREATE TABLE and INSERT statements: the tables and the rows the query runs on

reference.about: your own query that returns the right rows (it must return at least one)

ordered.about: yes when row order matters (ORDER BY is part of the task); default no
